name: Baek kimchi
description: Cabbage kimchi made without chilli — for children, and for the chilli-averse.

tcm.note: A ferment without chilli; cabbage is cooling.

ayurveda.note: Fermented, so ushna, but far less than the red kind.

histamine.note: Still a full ferment — leaving the chilli out removes the liberator, not the histamine.
